title: GPU Alley: Lantern ls, Dotfile Riddle & Lockpicks
summary: Your newly rewarded Oil Lantern unlocks `ls`! Sweep GPU Alley with `ls -la` to expose `.codec_spycam` (`rm`) and read `.tensor_rune` to solve `lantern_gate.sock`, then kill `keygen.exe`, delete `port_445/worm.bin`, and loot RAM + SSD before visiting the Hub!

files.content: Sweep hidden dotfiles with ls -la, read .tensor_rune, and echo its RUNE_PHRASE here!

winRules.description: Sweep hidden dotfiles with `ls -la` and remove `.codec_spycam` (`rm .codec_spycam`)
Use `ls -la` to find `.tensor_rune` and solve `lantern_gate.sock` (`echo amber_flame > lantern_gate.sock`)
Collect the second RAM stick (`mv ram_16gb.dimm ~`)
Collect the GPU Shader Core chip (`mv gpu_shader_core_01.img ~`)
